seller.description: Toast provides an all-in-one restaurant management platform combining point-of-sale, payment processing, kitchen display, guest engagement (marketing, loyalty, online ordering, reservations), team management (payroll, scheduling, tips), vendor/inventory management, AI-driven insights (Toast IQ), and finance tools (Toast Capital loans, Toast Checking) for restaurants and retailers of various sizes.

icp.offer: Toast Platform (the all-in-one restaurant management software including POS, operations, guest, team, vendor, and finance tools) for restaurant operations use.
icp.buyer: A person responsible for restaurant operations, finance, technology, or ownership at the account, specifically a Restaurant General Manager, Director of Operations, Controller, IT Manager, or owner; the buyer should not be reduced to just a founder or CEO.
